data.title: Parliamentary Secretary Ryan Turnbull highlights Government of Canada’s investments in community recreational facilities and ice rinks from Budget 2026: Masters of our destiny
data.author: Department of Finance Canada
data.summary: Arenas, ice rinks, and recreational facilities are at the heart of many communities across Canada. They are where so many Canadians first learn to skate, where young Canadians gather after school and adults lace up after work, and where families and friends huddle in the stands for the sports they love.
